text: No. P-45021/184/2020-PP (BE-II)/002 Government of India Ministry of Commerce and Industry Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (Public Procurement Section) Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi Dated April 1, 2021 Registration Certificate for M/s Neuman & Esser Engineering (India) Pvt. Ltd The undersigned is directed to refer to application of M/s Neuman & Esser Engineering (India) Pvt. Ltd Number NEA lndia/2020-21/DPIIT/12/App dated 09.09.2020 seeking registration in accordance with Department of Expenditure Order No. F. No. 6/18/2019-PPD dated 23.07.2020 and to convey that competent authority has approved grant of registration on the following terms and conditions to the entity mentioned below: Name of the Entity M/s Neuman & Esser Engineering (India) Pvt. Ltd Registered Address IT-121/122 MIDC Bhosari Pune 411026 Maharashtra Address of premises from T-121/122 MIDC Bhosari Pune 411026 Maharashtra where services are provided Items for which registration Reciprocating Gas Compressor Package has been sought Validity of the Registration 03 years from the date of issue of th is letter i.e. upto March 31, 2024 2. The Registration is only for the purpose of participation in public procurement in India in accordance with DoE order (Public Procurement No. 1) dated 23.07.2020 for supply of items (goods/works/services) from the premises mentioned above. 3. In case of appointment of new Director(s)/ new shareholders with more than 10% shares/ change in controlling ownership interest or control through other means, this registration shall automatically stand annulled . To, M / s Neuman & Esser Engineering (India) Pvt Ltd Address: T-121/122 MIDC Bhosari Pune 411026 Maharashtra Director Email: rajesh.gupta66@gov.in Page 1 of 1 -- 1 of 1 --
